# spo_home_site (Resource)

Manages the tenant home site (Set/Get/Remove-SPOHomeSite, CSOM). Singleton; not cleared on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_home_site" "this" {
  url = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/intranet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The home site URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
